source.source_name: APR Registar finansijskih izveštaja (Financial Statements) — Open Data API

transport.rate_limit: unknown (single GET returns the full ~57MB snapshot)

parsing.notes: {DatumPreseka, Podaci} map keyed by maticni_broj. Latest year only (GodinaFi). Monetary fields in thousands of RSD; ProsecanBrojZaposlenih is headcount.

mapping_rules.financials: One financial_statements[] entry: year=GodinaFi, total_assets=PoslovnaImovina, capital=Kapital, total_revenue=UkupniPrihodi, net_profit=NetoDobitak, net_loss=NetoGubitak, accumulated_loss=Gubitak, employees=ProsecanBrojZaposlenih. currency=RSD, unit=thousands.

fixture_requirements: company present in financials but absent in companies feed

live_test_plan.smoke: GET endpoint, decode Podaci, sample 100 entries; assert numeric fields parse.
live_test_plan.full: Stream monthly, join to apr_companies on maticni_broj; only latest year available.

blockers: Open feed exposes only the LATEST year — multi-year history needs the paid APR web service.
